subject: Launch ramp commit schedule & surge credit discussion
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@launchlabs.ai>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Launch ramp: monthly commit and surge expectations

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — LaunchLabs is excited to push the new in-app assistant in late Q3 (targeting a June public launch, ramping May–Aug). We want to discuss a monthly committed plan with step-up increases as throughput grows. High level:
- Pre-launch (May): ~40M tokens/month
- Launch (June): ~160M tokens/month peak
- Post-launch steady (July–Aug): ~90–120M tokens/month depending on seasonality

Questions:
1) How do your per-token discounts scale against monthly commits with step-up increases? Can we lock a rate for 6 months?
2) Do you offer surge credits or a launch-month protection if we overshoot the commit?
3) Any true-up process for month-over-month growth?

If helpful I can share a simple sheet with expected token curves. Would love a short call next week to align.

—Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of Product, LaunchLabs
procurement@launchlabs.ai

Attachments: LaunchForecast_Q2Q3.csv (stub)

From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@launchlabs.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-23T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch ramp: monthly commit and surge expectations

Hi Alice — great to connect. Thanks for the forecast; that shape (low pre-launch, big launch spike, then steadying) is exactly what our ramp/step-up commits are built for. Quick sketch attached (CommitSchedule_v1.xlsx) — it shows a 3-month ramp with monthly commit tiers and an optional launch surge credit. Highlights:
- Baseline per-token price (hosted API, standard models): $0.0008/token at 0–50M monthly commit
- Step-up tiers: 50–150M => 15% discount; 150–300M => 25% discount (applies to tokens within tier)
- Launch surge: one-time 30% overage coverage for the launch month (applies to first 50M over commit) if you accept a 6-month rate lock
- Monthly true-up: invoice based on actual usage with monthly reconciliation; overages beyond surge handled at overage rate or credited per agreement

Can we do a 30-minute call Thursday 3/25 to walk through the schedule and legal? Monica — looping you for pricing details and to flag procurement asks.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CommitSchedule_v1.xlsx (stub)

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-24T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: LaunchLabs - pricing recommendation and contract asks

Team — summary of the call with Alice and my take:
- LaunchLabs wants a predictable price at scale but needs headroom for a big launch month.
- Recommend we offer a 6-month rate lock on the agreed per-token band if they commit to the step-up schedule in the attached sheet.
- Offer structure: 3-tier step-up (0–50M, 50–150M, 150–300M) with progressive discounts; include a one-time "launch surge" buffer (first 50M over commit at 30% discounted overage credit).
- True-up process: monthly reconciliation, automatic offset to next invoice; excess beyond surge billed at agreed overage rate (or converted to committed volume for the following month if they want).

Open items for legal/procurement:
1) Define exact wording for "launch surge" (cap, timing, eligibility).
2) Confirm whether surge buffer can be used across two consecutive months (they asked about multi-month launches).
3) Confirm termination/true-up language for early exit.

Ben — can you prepare a priced redline (per-token by tier + example invoice math) so we can present to Alice? Marissa — can you flag any SLA/QoS exceptions for launch spikes?

Thanks — Monica

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@launchlabs.ai>, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-26T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Step-up commit schedule + pricing (LaunchLabs)

Alice / Rachel — following up with a written proposal based on the sheet and our discussion. Key economics (hosted API):
- Month 1 (May) commit: 40M tokens @ $0.00075/token (5.9% volume discount applied)
- Month 2 (June launch) commit: 150M tokens @ blended effective price $0.00060/token after tier discounts
- Months 3–4 (July–Aug) commit: 95M tokens/month @ $0.00065/token
- Step-up mechanics: tokens billed at the tiered rate for the bucket they fall into (we can provide worked examples).
- Launch surge credit: up to 50M tokens over the June commit covered at a 30% discount to the overage rate (effectively a credit on the June invoice)
- True-up & billing: monthly invoice, with line-item true-up and optional carry-forward of unused committed volume for up to 30 days.

Attached: Redwood_Master_Sub_2027-04.pdf (contract stub) and the commit schedule workbook. If you agree in principle we can spin a narrow DocuSign for signature and lock the 6-month rate.

Example math snippet (June):
- Committed: 150M => billed at committed blended price
- Actual usage: 205M => first 50M over covered by surge credit (discount applied), remaining 5M billed at overage rate ($0.00095/token)

Next steps:
1) Alice — does this align with procurement expectations?
2) If yes, I’ll prepare a HubSpot quote and DocuSign.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Master_Sub_2027-04.pdf (stub), CommitSchedule_v1.xlsx (stub)

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@launchlabs.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@launchlabs.ai
Date: 2027-03-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Step-up commit schedule + pricing (LaunchLabs)

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and close to what procurement needs. A few clarifying asks before legal reviews:
- Can launch surge be used across May/June combined (we might have pre-launch spikes)?
- Can we get a 6-month rate lock for the blended price if we commit to the 4-month stepped schedule?
- Would Redwood accept a short pilot addendum where the first month has a smaller commit but allows roll-forward to June?

If we agree on these items, procurement will share a PO. Please send DocuSign and a redline to our procurement inbox.

—Alice

From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@launchlabs.ai>, procurement@launchlabs.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Step-up commit schedule + pricing (LaunchLabs)

Alice — appreciate the clarifying questions. Short answers:
- Surge across May/June: we can extend the surge buffer to cover combined pre-launch + launch months (up to 50M total) if you accept the 6-month rate lock.
- 6-month rate lock: yes, Redwood will lock the agreed blended rates for six months from the date of signature.
- Pilot addendum: OK to include a pilot clause that allows a one-time roll-forward of unused May commit into June; we will capture that in the DocuSign addendum.

Ben/Monica/Marissa — can you prepare a redline that: 1) expands the surge language to "combined pre-launch + launch"; 2) includes a 6-month rate lock clause; and 3) adds the pilot roll-forward clause. If you get this to procurement by end of week we can have a signed PO early next week and onboard them into Dedicated onboarding queue for capacity planning.

Thanks all — next step: Ben to upload HubSpot quote and DocuSign link, Monica to confirm SLA notes, Marissa to validate ops capacity.

Rachel Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
